SELECT A.FEASIBILITY_STATUS, B.PRD_DESIGN_ID B_PRD_DESIGN_ID, B.REQUIREMENT_ID B_REQUIREMENT_ID, B.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME B_PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME, B.PRD_BASE_GOAL B_PRD_BASE_GOAL, B.PRD_CHARATER B_PRD_CHARATER, B.RAISE_TYPE B_RAISE_TYPE, B.INVEST_NATURE B_INVEST_NATURE, B.OPERATE_MODE B_OPERATE_MODE, B.TAR_CUSTOMER_TYPE B_TAR_CUSTOMER_TYPE, B.TAR_INVESTOR B_TAR_INVESTOR, B.RSK_LEVEL B_RSK_LEVEL, B.OPEN_DESCRIBE B_OPEN_DESCRIBE, B.PRD_TERM B_PRD_TERM, B.PLAN_ISSUE_DATE B_PLAN_ISSUE_DATE, B.PLAN_ISSUE_SCALE B_PLAN_ISSUE_SCALE, B.SALE_AREA B_SALE_AREA, B.BASE_RULE_INFO B_BASE_RULE_INFO, B.FEE_RATE B_FEE_RATE, B.TOFF_START B_TOFF_START, B.HUGE_RED_RATIO B_HUGE_RED_RATIO, B.INV_ASSET_RATE B_INV_ASSET_RATE, B.INTEN_INV_STRATEGY B_INTEN_INV_STRATEGY, B.OTHER B_OTHER, B.DATA_STATUS B_DATA_STATUS, B.CREATE_USER B_CREATE_USER, B.CREATE_DEPT B_CREATE_DEPT, B.CREATE_TIME B_CREATE_TIME, B.UPDATE_USER B_UPDATE_USER, B.UPDATE_TIME B_UPDATE_TIME
, C.SEQ_NO C_SEQ_NO, C.GENERATE_TIME C_GENERATE_TIME, C.MOCK_DATE C_MOCK_DATE, C.PRD_DESIGN_ID C_PRD_DESIGN_ID, C.PRD_SCALE C_PRD_SCALE, C.PRD_PERIOD C_PRD_PERIOD, C.RATE_MAX C_RATE_MAX, C.RATE_MIX C_RATE_MIX, C.REQUIREMENT_ID C_REQUIREMENT_ID, C.BATCH_ID C_BATCH_ID, C.DATA_STATUS C_DATA_STATUS, C.CREATE_USER C_CREATE_USER, C.CREATE_DEPT C_CREATE_DEPT, C.CREATE_TIME C_CREATE_TIME, C.UPDATE_USER C_UPDATE_USER, C.UPDATE_TIME C_UPDATE_TIME, D.AJUST_RISK_LEVEL AJUST_RISK_LEVEL
FROM PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT_ADD A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO B ON A.REQUIREMENT_ID = B.REQUIREMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN MOCK_RESULT_INFO C ON C.PRD_DESIGN_ID = B.PRD_DESIGN_ID
AND C.MOCK_DATE = (SELECT MAX(MOCK_DATE) FROM MOCK_RESULT_INFO WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MOCK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{generateTime} AND PRD_DESIGN_ID = #{prdDesignId} ) LEFT JOIN PRD_RISK_LEVEL D ON D.FIN_PRODUCT_CODE = B.PRD_DESIGN_ID
AND D.GENERATE_TIME = (SELECT MAX(GENERATE_TIME) FROM PRD_RISK_LEVEL WHERE DATE_FORMAT(GENERATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{generateTime} AND FIN_PRODUCT_CODE = #{prdDesignId})
WHERE B.PRD_DESIGN_ID = #{prdDesignId}
